Movie - Parineeta
Singers - Sonu Nigam & Shreya Ghoshal
Music - Shantanu Moitra
Lyricist - Swanand Kirkire
Cast - Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan, Sanjay Dutt, Raima Sen & Dia Mirza
Producer - Vidhu Vinod Chopra
Director - Pradeep Sarkar
